title: HeroUI chrome redesign — three locks
question: Confirm structure before rebuild. Pick the combination that matches how you trade.

options.label: Right dock · true light · full shell
options.thesis: Order ticket docks right (HeroUI drawer). Light mode is mist/white surfaces with ink text. Full chrome pass: top bar, rail, menus, panels, order ticket, bottom bar.
options.viewport: Dark or light shell; Place Order opens a clean right drawer; sun/moon at rail bottom.
options.risk: Largest pass — denser to ship, but one unified system.

options.label: Right dock · true light · order + shell skeleton
options.thesis: Same HeroUI system and light/dark tokens, but ship order panel + rail theme toggle + token layer first; restyle remaining windows in the next pass.
options.viewport: Theme switch works everywhere; order panel is the showcase; older menus stay until pass 2.

options.label: Floating ticket · true light · full shell
options.thesis: Order ticket is a floating HeroUI card (draggable), not a dock. Full shell restyle with light/dark.
options.viewport: Ticket overlays chart; rail still hosts theme toggle.
options.risk: Can cover candles; needs careful default position.

options.label: Right dock · soft gray light · full shell
options.thesis: Light mode stays low-glare gray (not white paper) for long sessions; otherwise same HeroUI full shell.
options.viewport: Day mode without pure white wash; night stays Obsidian black.
options.risk: Less brand-mist drama; calmer for all-day use.
